_comment: intelligence.json — shared style definition for the Intelligence Community style.
This file is the authoritative source for style-level conventions that span
multiple tools in the Edition pipeline:
md_harden  — reads 'hardening' to know what to flag and how to normalise
Markdown before conversion.
md2pdf     — engines/typst/styles/intelligence.typ and
engines/weasyprint/styles/style_intelligence.css implement
the rendering decisions listed in 'design' below.
When you change a convention here, update the corresponding engine file(s)
manually. The JSON is the spec; the .typ and .css are the implementations.
Style identity: US Intelligence Community analytical report.
Two-column serif body, navy + gold accent palette.
Defaults to DRASTIC / OSINT RESEARCH PRODUCT branding.

design._comment: Rendering decisions — implemented in intelligence.typ and style_intelligence.css.

_comment: Conventions that md_harden enforces when --style intelligence is passed.
Each rule has a 'confidence' (applied as the default Confidence% in the
review document) and an 'action' explaining what the transform does.
Rules with confidence >= 50 get Treatment: Apply; below 50 get Treatment: Review.

pull_quote_attribution._comment: The attribution line following a pull-quote block (| text).
pull_quote_attribution.action: Normalise 'Source:' → 'source:'. Lowercase is the house style — less intrusive than a capital label.

pull_quote_spacing._comment: A pipe immediately followed by a non-space character.

pull_quote_missing_source._comment: Pull-quote block with no following | source: line.
pull_quote_missing_source.action: Flag for review — missing attribution is often intentional (paraphrase, narrative).

_comment: Standalone bold-only paragraph (** text **) on its own line, followed
by a blank line → promote to H4.
Guards: skip if inner text > 80 chars (body emphasis, not a heading).
skip if next line is non-blank (definition term or lead-in).

strip_bare_sections._comment: Only strip if footnotes render per-page (Typst default). If notes are collected at end of document, the heading is required navigation — change Treatment to Apply only if you are using per-page footnotes.
strip_bare_sections.action: Remove bare ## Notes / ## References heading. Safe only when footnotes render inline per-page, not when collected as an end section.

et_al_italics._comment: et al. in in-text citations should be italicised per academic convention.
et_al_italics.action: Flag all plain 'et al.' for possible replacement with '*et al.*'. Low confidence — review before applying.

apostrophe_consistency._comment: Document mixes straight and curly apostrophes.
apostrophe_consistency.action: Advisory only — one example shown. Apply globally in editor with regex.

pull_quote_style_consistency._comment: Pull-quote lines that open without a quotation mark (possible unquoted paraphrase).
pull_quote_style_consistency.action: Advisory only — verify each is intentional before adding quotes.
